verses.text: Ayik tzex b'at owal, manh ex xiw t'a heb' eyajk'o'ol chi. Wach'chom tzeyila' to ek'to sb'isul heb' t'ayex, niwanpax sb'isul nok' schej heb' yet' scarruaje heb' yik owal yet' soldado heb', manh ex xiwok yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ik'jinak onh elta t'a Egipto, ha' ol och heyet'ok.
Ayik manto k'och yorail yoch owal chi', a winh sacerdote tz'alan t'a heb' soldado icha tik:
Ab'ek ex wetchonhab', a tiknaik toxo ol eyak' owal yet' heb' kajk'o'ol, mokab' chab'axk'e he k'o'ol, manh ex xiwok. Manh ex ib'xokk'e yuj xiwelal,
yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ayoch ket'ok. Ha ol ak'an owal yet' heb' kajk'o'ol chi', yuj chi' ol kak' ganar heb', xcham winh.

Slajwi chi', syalan heb' yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: Tato ay junok ex toto ix he b'ok'e he pat, manto ex ochlaj t'a yo'ol, meltzajanhek, k'inalok tzex cham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxo mach skajnajkan t'a yol he pat chi'.
Tato ay pax junok mach t'a ko kal tik ix yawej yuwa, manta jab'ok sat smolo', meltzajokab' t'a spat. K'inalok scham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxo mach smolan sat yuwa chi'.
Tato ay junok ex ayxo he trato he nupnaji, palta manto ex nupnajok, meltzajanhek yik tzex nupnaji. K'inalok tzex cham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxopax mach snupnaj yet' ix ix chi', xcham heb'.
Slajwi chi' syalanpax heb' yajalil soldado chi': Tato ayex tzex xiwi, meltzajanhek t'a he pat, yik wach' malaj heb' schab'axk'e sk'o'ol eyu'uj, xcham heb'.
Ayik slajwi slolon masanil heb' yajal chi', tz'ak'jioch yopisio junjun kuchb'um t'a junjun makan heb' soldado.
Tato tzex k'och t'a spatiktak junok chonhab' yik tzeyak'an owal yet'ok, b'ab'el tzeyala': ¿E gana am junk'olal, mato owal? xe chi.
Tato a heb' ay t'a jun chonhab' chi' snib'ej junk'olal, tzex scha'anoch heb' t'a yol schonhab' chi', yowalil tzeyak' pural heb' yochkan he chekab'ok.
Palta tato malaj snib'ej heb' yoch junk'olal heyet'ok jun, tato syal heb': Kak'ek owal, tato xchi heb', tzex oymaj t'a spatiktak schonhab' heb' chi', tzeyak'an owal.
Haxo Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'anoch heb' t'a yol he k'ab', ol he xikancham masanil heb' winh winak.

Haxonhej heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin, nok' molb'etzal nok' yet' masanil tas ay t'a jun chonhab' chi', heyik tz'ajkani. Tzex tzalaj yet' masanil tastak ol scha sk'ol Jehová ko Diosal yik skan t'a yol he k'ab', haton masanil tas ol eyik' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi'.
Ichanhej chi' ol he k'ulej yet' juntzanh nación najat ay b'aj ol ex kajnaj chi'.
Palta a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal eyikej, manhxa junok anima tzeyaktejkani.
Ol he satel juntzanh heb' tik: Eb' hitita, heb' amorreo, heb' cananeo, heb' ferezeo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo, icha wal ajnak yalan Jehová.

Icha chi' tzeyutej heb', yik wach' max ex sk'ayb'ej heb' he b'eyb'alan juntzanh tas te chuk sk'ulej ayik syak'anem sb'a heb' t'a diosal. Tato tze k'ulej tas sk'ulej heb' chi', tz'och he mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal.

Tato niwan tiempo tzex och hoyan t'a spatiktak junok chonhab', manh he ch'akel te te' sloji sat, yujto ol he lo sat te'. Ha te' awb'en te' chi', manh animaok te', max yal-laj skot te' t'ayex yak' owal heyet'ok.
Ha pax te' komon te' max loji sat jun, tze ch'akel te' yik tz'och te' he tek'nub'ok t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi', masanto satel jun chonhab' chi' eyu'uj.
